name: Auth0 for AI Agents
description: Auth0's agent auth suite: user login, delegated authorization and token vault.
descriptionZh: Auth0 的 Agent 认证套件：用户登录、委托授权与 Token Vault。
keyFact: Auth0 for AI Agents (formerly Auth for GenAI) handles user authentication, delegated authorization, asynchronous authorization via CIBA push/SMS confirmation and RAG authorization; its Token Vault calls third-party APIs on the user's behalf, and Auth0 FGA adds document-level fine-grained authorization, with integration into Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
keyFactZh: Auth0 for AI Agents（原 Auth for GenAI）处理用户认证、委托授权、基于 CIBA 推送/短信确认的异步授权以及 RAG 授权；其 Token Vault 可代表用户调用第三方 API，Auth0 FGA 提供文档级细粒度授权，并已与 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 集成。
caveat: Proprietary managed service; no self-hosted or open-source option.
caveatZh: 专有托管服务，无自托管或开源选项。
